Al-Masry Al-Youm 29-12-2010 article 'مبارك يفتتح خط الصعايد في أسوان' reports Minister Sameh Fahmy traveling to Aswan ahead of President Mubarak's inauguration of the Upper Egypt/South Valley gas line, confirms overall pipeline Dahshour-Aswan 930km/30-32in. Corroborated independently by petroleumafrica.com 'Mubarak Inaugurates Upper Egypt Gas Pipeline' (dated Jan 3 2011; gives LE5.7bn investment, 5-stage build, final stage Sohag-Aswan completed late Nov 2010, ceremony connects Aswan to gas grid for first time) -- both independent outlets, neither GEM, both confirm the pipeline reached/was operating to Aswan, which subsumes the Girga-Aswan segment (segment's own completion/operating status is also independently confirmed via the Ministry of Petroleum page cited on the Length/Location units below, which states all six phases including Gerga-Aswan were completed Nov 2009). Note: Ministry page says construction complete Nov 2009 vs formal presidential inauguration Dec 2010/Jan 2011 -- a normal completion-vs-ceremony gap, not a contradiction on the 'operating' value.
